verdict_reason: inc-087's criteria, detail and gate now say the pickers page at eight and name the chosen address, matching EUDPA-827 and ruling:ian-2026-11-23; only minor wording and scope gaps remain.

todos.issue: inc-087 acceptance criterion 7 says the count shows 'the rows shown out of every address the role holds', but after a search both frontends count against the matching addresses (plants address-book-picker/view-model.js:52 passes found.length to resultsCount), so the criterion misstates the count whenever a search term is set
todos.fix: Must: criterion 7 describes the count's total as the role's addresses that match the search (every role address when there is no search), as the code renders it. One way: reword to 'the count of the rows shown out of the role's matching addresses'.

todos.issue: inc-087's detail scopes paging to 'the high-risk plants frontend's consignor and place of destination pickers', while EUDPA-827 lists the plants consignment contact picker as affected too and it shares features/address-book-picker; with criterion 7 saying only 'each high-risk plants picker', the backlog never says the consignment contact picker pages, which is the re-distil gap the ticket asks to close
todos.fix: Must: the DR2.1 backlog states that the plants consignment contact picker pages at eight, alongside the consignor and place of destination pickers. One way: add a sentence to inc-087's detail (or criterion 7) naming the three plants pickers that share address-book-picker as paging at eight, while role filtering stays scoped as it is.

todos.issue: inc-087's first note still says the row 'Combines role filtering ... with one-page listing and dropping the restatement of the choice' and that 'The client module that carried a tick through the pagination links goes with the pagination'; this PR makes both untrue, and the correcting note (line 226) sits between the 2 November note and the 16 November note, so the notes read out of date order
todos.fix: Must: no note in inc-087 states the one-page listing or the removal of the restatement as current, and the notes read in date order. One way: mark the superseded sentences in the first note as overturned by ruling:ian-2026-11-23 (or strike them), and move the 23 November note after the 16 November exporter note.
